name: Spooky Bodies
description:
About This Game

Spooky Bodies is a charming puzzle game with a ghostly twist. In a world where nothing is as it once was, you take on the role of a ghost searching for your missing friends.

To rescue them, you'll need to solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and rely on a special ability: possessing lifeless bodies.

Spooky Bodies offers a relaxed puzzle experience for players of all ages and the whole family.

Walls, fences, and other obstacles often block your path in human form. In those moments, it's important to find and cleverly use traps to leave your physical body behind and become a ghost.

As a ghost, you can float through most physical barriers and explore the world in new ways.

As a ghost, however, your ability to interact with the environment is limited. So keep a close eye on your surroundings and look for lifeless bodies. Slip into them and bring them back to life to progress through the level.

After all, only in human form can you complete levels or influence the physical world.

In Spooky Bodies, you’ll encounter a variety of objects you can interact with. Use your human form to open doors, trigger pressure plates, push crates, or rotate a crossbow.

As a ghost, you can float through most obstacles with ease. But even in your spectral form, there are a few special objects waiting to be discovered and possessed.
short_desc: Spooky Bodies is a cozy puzzle game with a ghostly twist. Switch between ghost and human by using traps or possessing bodies. Each form offers unique abilities. Combine them cleverly and interact with the world to solve creative, brain-teasing puzzles.
